name: go-containerregistry-coherent-image-snapshots
instr:
go-containerregistry cannot capture a coherent, immutable generation of a v1.Image for stable inspection, validation, copying, and publication. Implement opt-in snapshots for daemon-backed, mutated, schema1, and ordinary coherent images without erasing implementation-specific capabilities or changing ordinary image, push, validation, pull, and copy behavior.

A completed snapshot must keep configuration, digest, size, annotations, raw bytes, and ordered layer identities mutually consistent and stable under repeated or concurrent observation, including duplicate DiffIDs. Reconcile daemon inspect data with memory- or file-buffered exports, freeze mutation state, preserve schema1 raw bytes and reversed filesystem-layer ordering, and reject contradictory generic images with `ErrIncoherentSnapshot` from `github.com/google/go-containerregistry/pkg/v1`.

Failure or cancellation must return no completed `ImageSnapshot`, report `SnapshotIncomplete`, preserve underlying errors alongside `ErrIncompleteSnapshot`, close acquired resources, permit independent retry, and never poison it. Publication of any v1.Image must use one completed snapshot for dependencies and image data, retaining dependency identities across pre-commit retries. Snapshot-enabled validation reads one captured generation; `validate.WithImageSnapshot` from `github.com/google/go-containerregistry/pkg/v1/validate` enables it.
